findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/rule-inventory.ts::verifyconfiglocation removal drops a wrong-file mismatch check
findings.title: verifyConfigLocation removal drops a wrong-file mismatch check
findings.action: No change: keep the guard removed; the refutation evidence stands.
findings.refutation: Guard recomputed the expectation with the same findConfigIn/findOverlayIn, the same rev-parse --git-common-dir from the same cwd/env, and the same .git-basename rule as findLocationWithMainFallback. Restored guard on FAFF-1463 with an instrumented fallback branch: branch reached in 11 layouts (deprecated name, overlay-only main, abs/relative/polluted GIT_DIR, separate-git-dir, non-ASCII path, symlinked worktree, config-is-dir), never refused; outputs identical with and without guard.
findings.disposition_rationale: On probe success the guard is equal to the shared lookup by construction; on probe failure FAFF-1463 throws first. Severity downgraded from critical.

occurrences.title: verifyConfigLocation removal drops a wrong-file mismatch check
